provider.description: Credential provider. Only allowed value is s3

awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS access key secret. This is not returned in the API.

region.description: AWS region in which the S3 bucket is located.

s3PathPrefix.description: The path prefix for the uploaded recording. Ex. "recordings/"

fallbackIndex.description: This is the order in which this storage provider is tried during upload retries. Lower numbers are tried first in increasing order.

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the credential.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the org that this credential belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the credential was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the assistant was last updated.

name.description: This is the name of credential. This is just for your reference.
